Noitom secures Huirong-backed Pre-A+++ round for robot training data

The company combines motion capture, dexterous-operation data and egocentric observations for different robot embodiments.

PEdaily ↗26 October 2026English editorial summary
Story

A new data-services financing round

Noitom Robotics has completed a Pre-A+++ round solely backed by Huirong Fund, according to the October 26 report. Founded in Beijing in 2012, it supplies data and infrastructure to robot builders, model teams and researchers. Financing size and valuation are undisclosed.

Three complementary collection systems

MOV covers large-space interaction, OM focuses on dexterous operation, and ITW+ captures multimodal egocentric observations in real environments. Together these address movement and object interaction rather than relying on a single visual data type.

Downstream performance remains unquantified

Noitom describes processing, annotation, quality checks and cross-embodiment mapping, with plans to broaden tasks and scenes. The report gives no new dataset volume, service price or measured improvement in model success. This is financing and service-development news, not a robot performance benchmark.
